BiblicalUsage: Mishmannah is named once, as the fourth of the Gadite captains who came to David at Ziklag. They were men of might and men of war fit for the battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the fourth name matters: David's army was built one faithful man at a time, and Mishmannah was one of them.
